name: Huntorf CAES (Germany, 1978) and McIntosh CAES (Alabama, USA, 1991)
description: Huntorf: world's first CAES plant, 290 MW (1978); McIntosh: 110 MW salt-cavern CAES storing air in a 19-million-cubic-foot cavern (1991)

sources.note: New York Times, 29 Sep 1991 (McIntosh 110 MW, 19-million-cu-ft cavern); Huntorf 290 MW 1978 per the widely cited Crotogino et al. Huntorf 20-years review (researchgate table mirror); read 2026-10-28
